def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']
    step = inputs['step']
    last_person = None
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    index = 0
    while len(people) > 0:
        index = (index + step - 1) % len(people)
        last_person = people.pop(index)
    return last_person
